items.title: Edmond Hall Interview, 1958-07-18
items.q: You take a guy like George Bronus, I tell you another guy is a good trombone player, fill in good

ctx.x: Would you say more to the tailgates now?

Yeah, it fits in the Dixieland band. You take a guy like George Bronus, I tell you another guy is a good trombone player, fill in good, he's cutty cut short, he's got a good idea of music, you know. And a lot of times you start to play the tune, a lot of times the harmony is easy. And if the guy know anything about the instrument, a lot of times the trombone player, he grab his note, the trombone player, grab his note, all the trumpet player, he's got to just play the melody and we've got some harmony going.
Sure. As far as syncopation is concerned, could you tell me what you mean when you say the syncopation?
